g.text: NOT A DIMENSIONED DRAWING — READ NOTE 1
ISO — 900 x 660 px, rendered off this shape
ISO2 — 900 x 660 px, rendered off this shape

RIGHT — 900 x 660 px, rendered off this shape
as modelled, Z up (Y is the long axis, 54.0000 mm)
CANNOT DETERMINE — no tool in this repo measures
AS PRINTED, layer lines along the build axis
1. THIS PART IS BACKED BY A PUBLISHED MESH, NOT BY A PARAMETRIC SOLID, SO IT CARRIES NO
DIMENSIONED DRAWING. Every number a drawing would call out — a hole diameter, a wall, a
radius, a fit — would be a measurement of a DECIMATED TRIANGULATION and not of the part. The
envelope above is exact because a bound on a triangle soup is exact; a diameter through one
is not. A parametric rebuild, graded against this mesh by cad-refcheck, is what restores the
2. PRINT THE NAMED FILE. Its sha256 is on this sheet so the shop can prove the bytes it sliced
are the bytes this sheet describes.
3. NO TOLERANCE IS STATED because none was measured. See the manufacturing document for the
4. Origin: generated. MEASURED off the solid: 0 holes, 0 arc radii in the R0.2..R60 band —
nothing to dimension — and 872 visible edges in the 'front' view (TechDraw.projectEx),
against 4-131 for a clean shop view on this shelf. The outline is a forest of construction
seams from a station-to-station loft through a measured table, not features to manufacture,
so a dimensioned drawing off it would be the 'unusable detail / random lines'
docs/MANUFACTURING-REQUIREMENTS.md A.1-A.2 forbids. This part is made by printing its
geometry. RADII NAMED IN THE BUILDER THAT ARE NOT ARCS ON THIS SOLID: R6.90, R7.20, R7.90.
cecad.inspect.arc_radii measures 0 arc(s) on it. These are DESIGN blends of a lofted surface
— real curvature, sampled station to station — and no circular edge carries them, so no
leader can be drawn to one and no dimension on this document is missing. What settles them
for a shop: the printed geometry file named on this sheet.
